name: IBY_LOGICAL_PMT_GROUPS
description: Group that contains payments that are logically grouped

columns.name: LOGICAL_GROUP_REFERENCE
columns.description: Unique identifier to qualify logical grouping for a payment

columns.name: PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: The date on which a payment transaction has to be paid to payee.

columns.name: INTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: The bank account used to disbursement of payments.

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_PRIORITY
columns.description: The priority with which a payment transaction should be processed.

columns.name: SERVICE_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: The service level with which a payment transaction should be processed.

columns.name: DELIVERY_CHANNEL_CODE
columns.description: The local instrument with which a payment transaction should be processed.

columns.name: BANK_CHARGE_BEARER
columns.description: The bearer of charge related to a payment transaction

columns.name: ULTIMATE_DEBTOR
columns.description: The person in receipt of goods/ services

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Payment methods by which the payments are grouped by.

columns.name: CATEGORY_PURPOSE
columns.description: Category purpose or payment function of the Payment.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
